contributions.title: HiTZ research center presented
contributions.note: The Basque Government presented HiTZ as a research center grouping the Ixa and Aholab groups of the University of the Basque Country.

contributions.title: Basque Government funding
contributions.note: The Basque Government announced 1.68 million euros for the center's language-technology research.

contributions.title: Latxa
contributions.note: Released a family of 7B to 70B Basque language models built on Llama 2, with a new Basque corpus and evaluation suite, under the IKER-GAITU project.

contributions.title: Latxa Instruct on Llama 3.1
contributions.note: Published instruction-tuned Latxa models for Basque at 8B and 70B and a public chatbot, with a crowdsourced arena collecting over 12,000 preference judgments.
